settings.title: Bras
settings.text:
Step 1: Find your band

  • Run the tape just below your bust, around your ribcage (line 1).
  • Keep it level and firm, not tight.

Step 2: Find your cup

  • Run the tape across the fullest point of your bust (line 2), over a bra without padding.
  • Keep it level and don't press down.

Find your numbers in the chart below.

settings.title: Panties
settings.text:
Step 1: Measure your waist

  • Place the tape around the narrowest part of your waist (line 1), usually in line with your belly button.
  • Keep it comfortable, not too tight.

Step 2: Measure your hips

  • Place the tape around the widest part of your hips and bottom (line 2).
  • Keep the tape straight all the way around.

Find your hip measurement in the chart below to get your panty size.

settings.title: Camisoles
settings.text:
Step 1: Measure your bust

  • Wrap the tape around the fullest point of your chest (line 1), level and not too tight.

Step 2: Measure your waist

  • Place the tape around the narrowest part of your waist (line 2), snug but comfortable.

Step 3: Measure your hips

  • Measure around the widest part of your hips and bottom (line 3), keeping the tape straight.

Use all three numbers to find your size in the chart below.

settings.title: Shapewear
settings.text:
Step 1: Measure your bust

  • Place the tape around the fullest point of your chest (line 1), straight across your back.

Step 2: Measure your waist

  • Wrap the tape around the narrowest part of your waist (line 2), near your belly button. It should feel snug but comfortable.

Step 3: Measure your hips

  • Place the tape around the widest part of your hips and bottom (line 3), level all the way around.

Use all three numbers to find your size in the chart below.
